description: This file declares the ServerManagerService class, which implements the IServerManagerService interface for managing server applications within the Rialto project. It includes method declarations for application initiation, session state changes, connection info retrieval, log level setting, and log handler registration, along with private logging functionality and internal state management.

classes.name: ServerManagerService
classes.description: Implements server management functionalities such as application lifecycle management, session state control, connection info retrieval, logging configuration, and log handling within the Rialto server manager service.

methods.name: ServerManagerService
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the service with a service context and number of preloaded servers.

methods.name: initiateApplication
methods.description: Starts an application session with specified app ID, session state, and app configuration.

methods.name: changeSessionServerState
methods.description: Changes the session server state for a given application ID.

methods.name: getAppConnectionInfo
methods.description: Retrieves connection information for a specified application ID.

methods.name: setLogLevels
methods.description: Sets the logging levels for the service.

methods.name: registerLogHandler
methods.description: Registers a log handler for logging purposes.

methods.name: forwardLog
methods.description: Private method to forward logs with detailed context such as file, line, function, and message.
